displayName: Lexical Relationships · TF-IDF Cosine Mutual kNN v1
description: An interpretable lexical passage-relationship graph that compares normalized TF-IDF term vectors with cosine similarity, retains only mutual ten-nearest-neighbor relationships, and records the strongest shared terms for each link.
calculation: The generator lowercased and Unicode-normalized passage text, removed a documented fixed English and archaic-function-word stop list, retained terms appearing in at least two passages and no more than 80 percent of passages, calculated sublinear term frequency and smoothed inverse document frequency, L2-normalized each sparse vector, calculated exact cosine similarity, ranked neighbors by descending similarity with passage ID as the deterministic tie-breaker, and stored each mutual 10-nearest-neighbor pair once. Existing DrL coordinates were held constant to isolate the relationship model.

representation.description: Each passage is represented by a sparse, L2-normalized vector of sublinear term-frequency and smoothed inverse-document-frequency weights.

layout.distanceMeaning: The x/y coordinates are the existing DrL coordinates held constant for controlled comparison; screen distance is not cosine similarity.
